title: A new Android malware from Google
summary: F-Droid documents the discovery and analysis of a new Android malware campaign, providing technical details about how the malicious software operates and evades detection on the Android platform.
problem_solved: Exposes and documents new Android malware threats that bypass standard security measures, helping the community understand emerging mobile security risks.
why_valuable: Provides critical security intelligence about Android threats, enabling developers and users to protect themselves against the latest malware campaigns.
